resources.string: Choose a service to create your first configuration.
This removes this configuration and its credentials. Other configurations are kept.
You can keep up to 20 configurations.
Save multiple configurations, including more than one for the same service. Tap a configuration to use it; Settings opens its editor. Duplicate and delete are in the editor menu.
Tests send a fixed example and do not save changes. Switching services keeps drafts in this editor. Save commits the selected service. Keys stay in encrypted storage on this device.
